description: Defines the HpackWholeEntryListener interface and a no-op implementation for handling complete HPACK entries in HTTP/2 header compression decoding.

classes.name: HpackWholeEntryListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to complete HPACK entries decoded from HTTP/2 headers.

classes.name: HpackWholeEntryNoOpListener
classes.description: A no-op implementation of HpackWholeEntryListener that ignores all callbacks.

methods.name: OnIndexedHeader
methods.description: Called when an indexed header is decoded.

methods.name: OnNameIndexAndLiteralValue
methods.description: Called when a header with a name index and literal value is decoded.

methods.name: OnLiteralNameAndValue
methods.description: Called when a header with literal name and value is decoded.

methods.name: OnDynamicTableSizeUpdate
methods.description: Called when the dynamic table size is updated.

methods.name: OnHpackDecodeError
methods.description: Called when a decoding error occurs.

methods.name: NoOpListener
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of a listener that ignores all calls.
